info.title: Datahub Query Service
info.description: Allows for the retrieval of reconciled and/or aggregated data sets from published collections

get.summary: Get a paginated list of published Collections
get.description:
Returns a list of published Collections with their metadata

Potential values for ontology:
idname
1financial-hierarchy-position
2chart of accounts
3entity
4account
5balance

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records in a collection to skip before starting the response set

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return in the result set

post.summary: Query a paginated list of Collections based on the Query request body
post.description: Returns a list of Collections with their metadata

requestBody.description: Query paginated list of Collection based on Filter condition

get.summary: Get a published Collection by ID

3entity

5balance
